_note: Relevance judgments (qrels) for the guideline corpus: physician-realistic queries mapped to the doc(s) that actually answer them. Consumed by measure.py + tests/test_retrieval_quality.py to compute AGGREGATE recall@k and MRR over the KEYLESS hybrid index (BM25 + hashed TF-IDF + noop rerank) — the retrieval quality that ships when no Cohere key exists. Every one of the 9 corpus docs is the target of >=1 query. If the corpus changes, re-derive these labels.

queries.query: can I keep metformin when kidney function is low
when do we start blood pressure medication

who qualifies for a statin without established heart disease
